summary_en: The video provides a step-by-step guide on how to prepare pan-fried egg-battered basa fish fillets with mayonnaise sauce, presented by two chefs in a studio kitchen. It begins with a preview of the finished dish and introductory dialogue, followed by ingredient preparation such as chopping green onions and slicing fish, mixing eggs with seasonings, frying the fish in a pan, plating, tasting, and concluding with a nutritional menu and recipe list.
